## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. Example: "I always have to manually do X and it's frustrating..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've already tried.

## Why would this benefit other users?

Explain how this feature would help the broader community of `git-ai-pilot` users.

## Additional context

Add any mockups, screenshots, or examples that help illustrate the idea.
